notes.content:

notes.title: Sorcerer's Dream update V2.6.0
notes.content:
[b]New feature:[/b] 
- Added "Display number" setting on OPTIONS screen. (for Multi-display environment)
- Added "Primary button" setting on OPTIONS screen.

[b]Improved / Fixed issue:[/b] 
- Fixed a case where Steam Overlay was not displayed correctly in windowed mode.
- Fixed a case where Steam Screenshots were not taken correctly in windowed mode.
- Fixed a case where Right-click of mouse devices was unresponsive.
- Optimized details of the operation using game controller.
- Fixed minor bugs.

[b]Note:[/b] 
If OPTIONS settings are not applied correctly after this update, please reset settings once.

[i]Thank you for playing![/i]

notes.title: Sorcerer's Dream update V2.2.0
notes.content:
In this V2.2.0 update, [u]existing saved Game Data (game progress) will NOT be carried over.[/u]
Please note that if you are playing.
Existing saved System Data (CG MODE flags, MUSIC MODE flags etc.) will be carried over.
Please be careful that if you are already playing.

[b]New feature:[/b]
- Jump from HISTORY window.

[b]Improved / Fixed issue:[/b] 
- Improved load speed.
- Fixed minor bugs.

[i]Thank you for playing![/i]
